headline: 5 measures name the same fear: China race
text:
Here is how your fear of AI is being used to centralize power today.

Five measures in one jurisdiction cite the fear that China is ahead, or about to be.

Five measures in five jurisdictions cite the fear that AI might get away from the people running it.

Five measures in four jurisdictions cite the fear that AI is built on work nobody paid for.

2,272 measures tracked. 760 carry a control, and they would hand new power to 100 offices.
